arabic text: YA RABBAL HUSSEIN, BE HAQQIL HUSSEIN,\nISHFE SADRIL HUSSEIN, BI ZUHURIL HUJJAT
english translation text: OH LORD OF HUSSAIN, FOR THE SAKE OF HUSSAIN, CURE THE HEART OF HUSSAIN WITH THE APPEARANCE OF THE HUJJAH

arabic text: YA RABB TUJHE HUSSEIN KE ZAKHMO KA WAASTA,\nYA RABB TUJHE HUSSEIN KE BACHON KA WAASTA,
english translation text: O LORD, FOR THE SAKE OF HUSSEIN’S WOUNDS,\nO LORD, FOR THE SAKE OF HUSSEIN’S CHILDREN

arabic text: DETI HUN WAASTA TUJHE QABRE HUSSEIN KA,\nQAYAM RAHE YE MAJLIS-O-MATAM KA SILSILA
english translation text: FOR THE SAKE OF HUSSEIN’S GRAVE,\nMAY THIS CONGREGATION AND MOURNING CONTINUE ON.

arabic text: (MAWLA SAB BEHNON KE\nBHAIYYON KO SALAMAT RAKHE)
english translation text: MAY GOD KEEP ALL SISTER’S\nBROTHERS IN GOOD HEALTH

arabic text: NEZON NE CHAAN DAALA THA SINAN JAWAAN KA,\nWOH AKBARE HUSSEIN WOH HUMSHAKLE MUSTAFA,
english translation text:
SPEARS REPEATEDLY STABBED
THE YOUNG MAN’S CHEST,
THAT AKBAR, SON OF HUSSEIN,
WHO LOOKED LIKE MUSTAFA,

arabic text: WOH TERI BAARGAAH ME KARTA HAI YE DUA,\nBHAI KISI BAHAN KA NA BICHRE MERE KHUDA,
english translation text: IN YOUR PLACE, HE MADE THIS PRAYER,\nDO NOT SEPARATE ANY SISTER\nFROM HER BROTHER, OH MY LORD.

arabic text: KAANON KA KHUN NAZR KIYA JIS YATIMAA NE,\nMARNA QUBUL KARLIYA BAALI SAKINA NE,
english translation text: SHE LET HER EARS BLEED, THIS LITTLE ORPHAN GIRL\nSHE ACCEPTED THE DEATH, THIS LITTLE SAKINA

arabic text: ARE LEKIN TERI RIZA SE NA USKA QADAM HATTA,\nYA RABB NAZAR BA KUNBA MAZAAR E SHIKASTA PA
english translation text: BUT SHE DID NOT ACCEPT ANYTHING THAT WENT AGAINST YOUR WILL\nOH LORD, KEEP AN EYE OVER THE RUINED SHRINES

arabic text: (DUA KARTE HEIN IN ASHKON KE WASILE SE,\nISS MAATAM KE ZIKR KE WASILE SE,
english translation text: WE ARE PRAYING, FOR THE SAKE OF THESE TEARS\nAND FOR THE SAKE OF THIS MOURNING,

arabic text: JO KERBALA NAHIN GAYE MERE MAALIK,\nISSI SAAL KERBALA KI ZYARAT SE MUSHARRAF HON)
english translation text: THOSE WHO DID NOT GO TO KARBALA, MY LORD,\nHONOUR THEM WITH A PILGRIMAGE\nTO KERBALA THIS YEAR,

arabic text: TO LABON PAR HO YE SADAA,\nJAANA HO KERBALA, JAANA HO KERBALA\nHOGI NA RADD DUA KABHI RAIHANN OUR RAZA,
english translation text:
LET’S GO TO KERBALA, LET’S GO TO KERBALA,
WITH THESE WORDS ON OUR LIPS
OUR PRAYERS WILL NEVER BE REJECTED,
REHAN AND RAZA,

arabic text: KEHNA AB USKO BHEJDE JISKO CHUPPA LIYA,\nDIL ME KHUDA KHUDA HO, TO LABB PAR HO YA HUSSEIN
english translation text: IN OUR HEARTS, WE HAVE ALLAH, AND ON OUR LIPS IS 'YA HUSSEIN',\nASK HIM TO SEND WHO IS HIDING BY THE ORDERS OF OUR LORD (IMAM MAHDI)
